latencies.notes: Data-dependent latency: 8 cycles for 0/Inf/NaN/negative; 10 for exact squares 1, 4, 0.25 and minnorm; 36 for general non-square inputs; 37 for maxsub. Measured with an integer-bit reset chain; 5 cycles of helper latency are subtracted. The sample experiment uses 1.0.

throughput.notes: Data-dependent throughput: CPI 4.5 for special values; 5.5 for exact squares; 18.5 for general inputs; 19.0 for maxsub; 6.0 for minsub. Throughput is initiation-interval bound.

notes: Latency model, fitted and validated on this core with a two-copy chain (the stored experiment runs the operation twice, subtracts the 6-cycle closure and divides by 2). Classes: 8 cycles for special operands (0, Inf, NaN), 10 cycles for the exact / power-of-two path (the stored sample uses 1.0), 36 cycles for a general operand. For 32-bit lanes the vector latency equals 2 x the scalar latency - 5, because the 32-bit lanes make two passes over the 64-bit datapath and share the setup/rounding. 64-bit vector lanes match the scalar numbers exactly and run in parallel, only the slowest lane matters.
